title: Asteroid Collision
summary: Given an array of integers representing asteroids, determine the state after all collisions.
statement: Given an array of integers representing asteroids, determine the state after all collisions. For each asteroid, its size is the absolute value and direction is indicated by the sign. Collisions occur when asteroids move towards each other; the smaller one explodes, and if equal, both explode. Asteroids moving in the same direction do not collide.
constraints: Asteroids are nonzero integers; sign is direction and magnitude is size.
Only a positive asteroid left of a negative one can collide; equal sizes destroy both.
hints: Only unresolved right-moving asteroids on a stack can meet a new left-mover.
Pop smaller opposing tops; then resolve equality, a larger top, or survival.
While top>0>current and top<abs(current), pop; handle remaining collision; otherwise append.
Each asteroid is pushed and popped at most once, and the stack always represents the stable processed prefix.
editorial: Each asteroid is pushed and popped at most once, and the stack always represents the stable processed prefix.

Equal opposing asteroids destroy each other.
